# Dave Webster — "Charles clean-up materials" (2009)

**Status:** VERBATIM SOURCE. Do not edit, tidy, or improve.
Interpretation belongs in [2009-supply-and-goals-analysis.md](2009-supply-and-goals-analysis.md).

**Provenance:** attachment `Charles clean.docx` on an email from `DWebs49484@aol.com`,
subject **"Cleanning products    David"**, sent 2009-11-10 to
`charles.warloe@gmail.com`. The email body was empty. Charles replied the next
day: *"Nice work, sir!"* Retrieved 2026-09-19 via Google Drive.

**This is the direct ancestor of the materials list in the
[2023 notes](2023-07-17-dave-webster-cleanup-notes.md)** — same title, same
structure, nearly the same contents, fourteen years earlier.

Numbering and lettering irregularities are his.

---

> **Charles clean-up materials**
>
> **Kitchen**
>
> Glass top oven cleaner
>
> Granite cleaner (counters)
>
> Pine Sol (lemon scent) for floor
>
> Mr. Clean spray cleaner (409 ok too) for cleaning refrig., cupboards, microwave etc.
>
> Windex (for windows)
>
> Sponge mop
>
> Sponges, or wash cloths
>
> Soft scrub for sink
>
> Pledge, for woodwork, table, bar.
>
> **Main house**
>
> Vacuum cleaner, cleaner bags
>
> Broom
>
> Windex for windows
>
> Pledge for wood work
>
> Swiffer for dusting, and at least one replacement box
>
> **Bedrooms**
>
> a.Swiffer
>
> b. Vacuum
>
> c. Windex
>
> d Broom
>
> e.Mop
>
